description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hapuwalana, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510050
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to specific land parcels (Nos. 359, 357 and 358) in Hapuwalana village, including details about the owners, extent of land, and ownership status. The content is exclusively focused on land and property matters, falling clearly under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
